plan.title: Remove a PR cart item with the trash icon

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions area required to begin from a PR cart.
Use the Open tab because only open PRs can be used to enter sourcing.
Select a PR containing at least two line items so one can be removed.
Open the selected PR's purchase-items cart where the line-item trash controls are available.
Click the trash icon for one cart line, exercising the requested removal action.
Confirm the cart remains rendered without an application error after the removal.
